meta.homeDescription: GaraPro opens an assistance channel within 15 minutes: a named mechanic and a stated arrival time. Call or message on WhatsApp.
meta.coverageDescription: Mechanics based in Douala, Yaoundé, Bafoussam, Bamenda, Garoua, Buea, Limbé, and Ngaoundéré. Outside a city, the arrival time is confirmed before anyone sets off.
meta.engagementDescription: What the 15 minutes include, how the price is set, and how the mechanic is identified before leaving.
meta.privacyDescription: What GaraPro does with the information you share by phone or WhatsApp.
meta.termsDescription: GaraPro creates a channel for fast assistance and is not liable for defects caused by the mechanics it sends.

actions.whatsappPrefill: Hello GaraPro, my car has broken down. My location is:

hero.title: Broken down, wherever you are.
hero.promise: Within 15 minutes, a mechanic is named and an arrival time is given. That time depends on where you are.
hero.figureCaption: A mechanic is named. An arrival time is given.

steps.title: Three steps. Nothing else.
steps.oneBody: Describe the breakdown by phone or WhatsApp, and share your location.
steps.twoBody: Within 15 minutes you have the mechanic's name and the time they will arrive.
steps.threeBody: Repair on site or a tow, at the price agreed before any work starts.

values.title: Speed, efficiency, integrity.
values.speedBody: A mechanic is assigned to you within 15 minutes.
values.efficiencyBody: One channel, one mechanic, and no call-centre loop.
values.integrityBody: An identified technician, a price before work, and an arrival time before anyone sets off.

coverage.title: They set off from here.
coverage.intro: The nearest mechanic sets off from one of these cities.
coverage.outBody: If you are far from a city, help sets off from the nearest base. The arrival time is confirmed before anyone leaves. If that time does not work for you, nothing is booked.

faq.title: Before you call.
faq.oneA: These 15 minutes are the response time the mechanic can take to actually reach you and assist you.
faq.twoA: Yes. The channel is open at night and on weekends.
faq.threeA: Cash, MTN Mobile Money, or Orange Money. The amount is set with the mechanic before the work starts.
faq.fourQ: What if I am far from a city?
faq.fourA: The mechanic sets off from the nearest base. The arrival time is confirmed before they leave.

close.title: Say where you are.
close.body: A call or a WhatsApp message is enough to open the channel.

engagement.title: Speed is counted. Integrity is checked.
engagement.intro: You know who is coming, when they arrive, and what it costs, before any work begins.
engagement.include3: An arrival time is given from your location.
engagement.exclude1: The mechanic standing next to the car in 15 minutes, no matter the distance.
engagement.exclude2: The repair. GaraPro opens the channel. The mechanic does the work.
engagement.termsLink: The limit of liability is written in the terms and conditions.
engagement.qual1: You know the mechanic's name before they leave.
engagement.qual2: They leave only after the arrival time has been given.
engagement.price1: The amount is agreed before the bonnet is opened.
engagement.price2: No extra charge is announced once the work has started. Payment is in cash, MTN Mobile Money, or Orange Money.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.who1: GaraPro runs a roadside assistance channel in Cameroon. For any question about your information, call us or message us on WhatsApp at the number published on this site.
privacy.site1: This site does not create an account and has no form. It does not set analytics cookies or advertising cookies.
privacy.site2: You can read these pages without giving a name, a number, or a location.
privacy.channel1: You ask for help by phone or WhatsApp. You may then share your number, your location, your vehicle, and what has gone wrong.
privacy.channel2: That information is used only to open the assistance channel: to name a mechanic and to give an arrival time.
privacy.third1: WhatsApp is Meta's service. A phone call goes through your carrier. Their own rules apply to what travels on their networks.
privacy.rights1: We do not sell this information.
privacy.rights2: You can ask to see what you sent us, or ask us to delete it, by contacting the number published on this site.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.channel1: GaraPro only creates a channel for fast assistance. GaraPro puts you in contact with a mechanic. GaraPro does not perform the repair.
terms.channel2: The service is to answer you, name a mechanic, and give you an arrival time.
terms.minutes1: Within 15 minutes the channel is open: a mechanic is named and an arrival time is given.
terms.minutes2: That window is not a promise that GaraPro fixes the car, and it is not a promise that the mechanic is at your door in 15 minutes. Arrival depends on your location and is stated before anyone sets off.
terms.mechanic1: The mechanic is solely responsible for the diagnosis, the work, and the result.
terms.mechanic2: The price is agreed with the mechanic before work starts.
terms.liability1: GaraPro is not liable for any defect, damage, or faulty work caused by the mechanics sent to assist you.
terms.liability2: A complaint about the quality of the work is for the mechanic who did it.
terms.client1: You give an accurate location and an accurate description, and you stay in a safe place to stop.
terms.contact1: For any question about these terms, call GaraPro or write on WhatsApp at the number published on this site.
